bullets.text: Regulators Propose Crypto Rules — The SEC and Financial Accounting Standards Board introduced new proposals for crypto asset regulations, aiming to provide clearer capital-raising pathways for entrepreneurs and investors.
FCA Supports Innovative Firms — The Financial Conduct Authority has launched a Scale-up Unit to assist five fast-growing UK fintech firms in navigating regulations and fostering sustainable growth.
FCA Launches Compliance API — A new API from the FCA simplifies access to regulatory rules, helping firms integrate compliance requirements more efficiently into their systems.
Payments Modernisation Costs — Legacy payment systems are proving costly for banks, leading to lost revenue and customer frustration, highlighting the need for modern, flexible technology solutions.

Experian Utilises AI for Credit — Experian has launched a credit card app on ChatGPT, showcasing the growing trend of integrating artificial intelligence into financial services for enhanced user experience.
